subject: How to use RGL, scatterplot3d with RApache

messages.author: 1bf3bb84a245eefc
messages.subject: How to use RGL, scatterplot3d with RApache
parts:
Hi All,

On a desktop computer the following R code creates a 3d plot which can
be rotated with the help of a mouse:

# Spinning 3d Scatterplot using mtcars data

library(rgl)
library(scatterplot3d)
attach(mtcars)


plot3d(wt, disp, mpg, col="red", size=3)


How can I achieve the same results with RApache.

I understood very well how to create a PNG or JPG image and display
via an <img src="" /> tag.
Any help in this regard will be greatly appreciated.

messages.author: afb533de9e54dd1c
messages.subject: Re: How to use RGL, scatterplot3d with RApache
parts:
Hi there,

in a similar situation here. Even though rApache run as a local
service manages to pop up an X11 window with the 3d plot on it, any
interaction with it is lost, not even resizing-redraw is possible.

A suitable solution I've used in the past to share these 3D plots with
non-R users was to generate a 3D VRML chunk then rely on an external
viewer to open it. I guess it may be possible just to do so then embed
that VRML inside your browser page by means of the proper plugin. RGL
still produces nicer outputs but with some tweaking VRML can do the
job.

Hope it helps,

Oscar

the package I used is animation. If you use the saveSWF() you can
rewind and pause the animation. That may be an option?
